translations.english: He saw the mountain endowed with a thousand peaks, its caves inhabited by lions, and its waters falling from waterfalls, resembling the ocean with its loud laughter.
translations.hindi: अतएव हे जत्युदेव ! में तुम्हारी प्राथना करती हूँ कि, तुम मुझ दु.खियारी को ले चलों । हा ! पूर्वजन्म में हमसे ऐसा कौनसा पापकम बन पड़ा था
